name: review-failure-state
summary: Added failed status update in DocumentUploadSection catch block; moved newDocument variable outside try scope so catch can access it; notify parent list on failure.
completed_work: Moved newDocument declaration from const inside try block to let outside try block so the catch handler can reference it.
Added documentStorage.updateStatus(newDocument.id, 'failed') in the catch block when newDocument was successfully created before the error.
Added onDocumentAdded() call in the catch block so the parent DocumentsList re-renders and shows the failed badge.
Used non-null assertion (!) for newDocument references inside the try block since it's guaranteed to be assigned after create().
Existing DocumentsList getStatusBadge() already renders failed status with destructive variant + '실패' label — no UI changes needed.
decisions: Did not add a separate onDocumentFailed callback — reused existing onDocumentAdded to trigger list refresh. The DocumentsList already re-fetches from storage and renders the failed badge.
Did not modify lib/types.ts — the Document.status union type already includes 'failed'.
Did not modify lib/storage/local-storage.ts — documentStorage.updateStatus() already handles any valid status string including 'failed'.

contract_surface_for_step3.DocumentUploadSection: handleUpload creates a document, calls processDocumentReview, and on success sets status=completed + stores results. On any error after document creation, sets status=failed and notifies parent via onDocumentAdded.
contract_surface_for_step3.DocumentsList: Renders failed documents with destructive badge '실패'. '결과 보기' button disabled for non-completed statuses.

verification: npm run build --prefix projects/DraftReviewr → passed (Next.js 15.2.4, all routes static)
known_issues: If documentStorage.create() itself throws (e.g., localStorage quota exceeded), no document is created and no failed status is set — this is correct behavior (nothing to mark as failed).
next_actions: Run Step 3 (product-contract-alignment): align README, API key settings UI copy, and supported file format claims with actual implementation.
resume_hint: Step 2 complete. Document failure state is now properly handled. Proceed to step 3: product-contract-alignment.
